role: Successful Caduceus appliance statistics history reply

evolution.missing_field_semantics: Unselected tiers are empty arrays; load_context is present only when the gate attaches a trace.

retention.description: Retention durations in seconds and capacity in points for the one-second raw tier and both one-minute tiers.

raw.description: Description of the memory-backed one-second samples.

averages.description: Metric paths covered by the minute aggregation.

tier.description: Both selects raw and minute; self is requested separately.

since.description: Lower bound in Unix seconds, before any extra raw retention clamp.

limit.description: A provided limit is clamped and reported as one integer; when omitted the object reports the defaults for each tier.

tiers.description: Each selected tier returns up to its limit of newest eligible rows, ordered oldest first. Unselected or empty tiers return an empty array.

minute.description: Stored minute samples carry schema, bucket (Unix minute), samples, aggregation (nullable means and RSS/tick maxima), and partial when the stored minute was cut short.

self.description: Stored per-minute self benchmarks carry schema, bucket, tick and persist timing percentiles, skippedTicks, rss, db, arena, doors, and mallocTrim.

400.description: Axum's query extraction rejection for malformed query parameters, not a history reply.

403.description: The command gate refused or its carapace was not readable.

503.description: An unsupported tier, raw inflate/UTF-8 error or SQLite read error is mapped to the gate's firstMissingSignal (normally caduceus-operation-failed). A worker join failure reports caduceus-blocking-task-join-failed. No partial history reply is emitted.

canonical_bytes: UTF-8 JSON, two-space indentation and one trailing LF. GET schema serves these exact file bytes.
